title: Archaeological, structural, and compositional observations of the concrete architecture of the Basilica Ulpia and Trajan’s Forum
version: Building Roma Aeterna, Commentationes Humanarum Litterarum 128, pp. 73–95
lineage: Authors’ copy rendered as searchable article text. Fabrizio Marra also co-authored Lancaster et al. (2011); the detailed fragment description is complementary evidence from a shared site and overlapping team.

passages.quote: in well compacted, alternating courses parallel to the flat upper and lower surfaces of the vault
passages.note: The authors document yellow tuff and brown scoria as alternating coarse aggregate courses in fragment 10, and describe distinct fine ingredients in its mortar. A 1932 excavation photograph records the fragment, attributed to a minor aisle on the northwest side.
